reviews.reason: Render jhoti-chita as jhoti drawings, avoiding the misleading Hindi plural चिताओं while retaining the cultural anchor.
reviews.reading_evidence: Read six source stanzas (5/6/4/5/3/4) and both complete targets/title: river own song/cadence with anklets as restraint, bird freedom and opened cage; night dhim-dhim from earth sanctum/pure darkness; morning lotus feet on jhoti-chita and cleaned light courtyard; trees consecrated by pure air; life free of affliction/creation nectar and repeated sweetness. Preserve devotional diction and freedom-of-natural-forms structure without forcing rhyme or reducing imagery to environmental advice.
reviews.tradeoff: The visual designs remain identified as jhoti; this is a contextual rendering of Odia ଝୋଟିଚିତା, not a replacement of every chita occurrence.
